source_text: ge-hirdness, e; f. Keeping guard, watchful care. Take here ge-heordnes, ge-hyrdnes in Dict. , and add :-- On h&u-long; mycelre Godes gehyrdnysse beó&d-bar; þ&a-long; þe cunnon h&y-long; sylfe forseón on þysum l&i-long;fe in quanta custodia sunt qui in hoc vita seipsos despicere noverunt, Gr. D. 39, 29.
